comparisonPolicy.cappedDistance: Unit-cost Levenshtein scaled by 100; saturation cap is floor(maxCost/100)+1 (3 for the default budget).
comparisonPolicy.cspellWeighted: Symmetric ASCII letters/digits map: insertion/deletion 100, substitution 150, adjacent swap 100; fallback edit cost 150.
comparisonPolicy.affineGap: Global Gotoh score negated: match 0, substitution 150, either insertion or omission run 100+(length-1)*20.
comparisonPolicy.shared: Exact-match bypass, minimum input length, maximum cost, and minimum gap follow each corpus case.
comparisonPolicy.differences: Comparators have no maxEvents, omission length/ratio limits, retained-neighbour repetition weighting, or configured keyboard weighting. Their string units and alignments are their own APIs. Scalar comparator results omit operation explanations. Throughput is not an equivalent-result speedup claim.

qualityLimitations: Selected flags are not a random sample. Some repository inputs are deliberate fixtures. Intended corrections are inferred, not logged keystrokes. Unselected flags include valid identifiers and names.

workloadPolicy.preparation: One createMatcher call per iteration; candidate snapshots, code-point arrays, exact lookup, and preparation statistics included.
workloadPolicy.lookups: HTML batch has 7 probes; identifier batch has 6. One-shot includes a fresh preparation per probe; prepared excludes preparation. Explanation and completion-statistics creation included; progress callbacks disabled.
workloadPolicy.sizeAndRepetition: One prepared lookup per iteration; vocabulary and immutable input construction excluded. Long-omission workload explicitly allows 9 omitted code points and cost 300.
workloadPolicy.consumers: Existing perf fixtures are separate from explicit typo workloads: six entities in one document, and five media calls per iteration. Before/after outputs intentionally differ under conservative ambiguity policy.
workloadPolicy.preparationLatency: Milliseconds per preparation are derived from measured mean seconds per iteration; normalized scores remain the throughput comparison evidence.
workloadPolicy.memory: Heap differences over 30 retained matchers after explicit garbage collection; approximate retained heap only, not peak allocation or process RSS.
